title: BGP Support for Four-Octet Autonomous System (AS) Number Space
summary: Extends BGP so Autonomous System numbers can be carried in four octets instead of two. This expands the supply of AS numbers. It is a standards-track document, replaced by RFC 6793.

eli5.summary: Two-digit house numbers ran out, so this lets networks use longer ones. It makes more numbers available for the networks that make up the Internet.

questions: how does bgp support 32-bit as numbers
